NIO Inc. Provides October 2026 Delivery Update

 

·34,246 vehicles were delivered in October 2026

·334,547 vehicles were delivered year-to-date in 2026, increasing by 38.5% year-over-year

·Cumulative deliveries reached 1,332,139 as of October 31, 2026

 

SHANGHAI, China, November 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NIO Inc. (NYSE: NIO; HKEX: 9866; SGX: NIO) (“NIO” or the “Company”), a pioneer and a leading company in the global smart electric vehicle market, today announced its October 2026 delivery results.

 

The Company delivered 34,246 vehicles in October 2026. The deliveries consisted of 18,125 vehicles from NIO brand, 8,383 vehicles from ONVO brand, and 7,738 vehicles from FIREFLY brand. Cumulative deliveries reached 1,332,139 as of October 31, 2026.

 

On October 23, 2026, the NIO All-New ES8 reached its 160,000th delivery. From January to October 2026, the NIO All-New ES8 has ranked first in cumulative retail sales volume in both the large SUV segment and the RMB400,000-level vehicle segment in China. As the industry transitions from spec-led to brand-driven competition, sustained sales momentum for the NIO All-New ES8 further enhances recognition of the NIO brand in the premium market.

 

About NIO Inc. 

NIO Inc. is a pioneer and a leading company in the global smart electric vehicle market. Founded in November 2014, NIO aspires to shape a sustainable and brighter future with the mission of “Blue Sky Coming”. NIO envisions itself as a user enterprise where innovative technology meets experience excellence. NIO designs, develops, manufactures and sells smart electric vehicles, driving innovations in next-generation core technologies. NIO distinguishes itself through continuous technological breakthroughs and innovations, exceptional products and services, and a community for shared growth. NIO provides premium smart electric vehicles under the NIO brand, premium smart electric vehicles for families through the ONVO brand, and high-end smart electric compact cars with the FIREFLY brand.
